questions.stem: A researcher is analyzing a segment of double-stranded DNA as part of an experiment to understand gene expression in a particular type of cancer. The researcher finds that in this DNA segment, thymine makes up 28% of the nucleotides. Based on this information, what is the percentage of guanine in this DNA segment?
